임무고 뭐고 모두 잊고 싶습니다. 이전 퀘스트에 대한 보상을 받고 싶습니: Forget the mission, forget everything. I just want the reward for my previous quest.
No, it's nothing. I was just saying it.
The mission is a bit much for me. I'll take it on again later.
정 그렇다면 할 수 없는 일이지. 하지만 말야 상사이기보다는 선배로써 충: If that's how you feel, there's nothing to be done. But let me give you a word of advice, not as your superior but as an elder - think it over once more.
I believe I did my best. I'd just like to receive my reward.
If it's your advice, I'll think it over once more.
내가 제군에게 임무를 맡겼던가? 내 정신이 이상해진 건가 아니면 제군이: Did I give you a mission? Am I losing my mind, or have you gotten something confused?
자유대결지대는 동족간의 대결을 위한 '올테니아'와 동족,타 종족에 관계없: The Free Combat Zone has 'Oltenia' for duels between your own kind, and 'Vanatul' where you can freely fight regardless of race. Choose one.
I'd like to go to Oltenia.
어서오시게나~ 바토리 쪽에서는 누가 가장 위대하던가? 브리콜라카스? 내: Welcome~ Who's the greatest on Bathory's side? Vrykolakas? There's little to learn from someone who can't even come close to me. I'll teach you things you can't learn from books. But... you're confident, aren't you?
I came because there's something I want to ask you.
Please teach me the great magics you know.
I'd like to see your weapons and beads.
I'd like to go to the Perona Highway.
I'd like to receive the test server gift.
더 연습한 후에 다시 오도록 하겠습니다. 그때는 당신의 제자로 받아주십시: I'll practice more and come back later. Please accept me as your disciple then.
역시 자네는 블러드님의 충실한 부하일세. 가서 그 간교한 바토리년의 목을: As expected, you're a loyal servant of Lord Vlad. Go and cut off that cunning Bathory witch's head. Ah! I nearly forgot something important. Do you know about the necklace that symbolizes the Masters? The Masters, who represent their races, each wear a necklace made of a pendant and bijou that can control and amplify their magical power.
Please tell me more about it.
알겠습니다. 이만 가 보겠습니다: Understood. I'll be on my way now.
우리의 블라드님에 대항하는 바토리와 질드레라는 자들이 있지. 그들 역시: There are those who oppose our Lord Vlad - Bathory and Gilles de Rais. They too are among the most cunning of the Vampire Masters, forever scheming to seize the Blood Scripture in pursuit of eternal, undying power. Ah! I nearly forgot something important. Do you know about the necklace that symbolizes the Masters? The Masters, who represent their races, each wear a necklace made of a pendant and bijou that can control and amplify their magical power.
팬던트와 비쥬는 모두 보석의 일종이라네. 상당한 마력을 갖고 있지. 모두: Both the pendant and the bijou are a kind of gem, each holding considerable magical power. Both are formidable, but the pendant is the core of the necklace - it plays the most central role in controlling magical power. A Master who loses it can no longer control their own power and will destroy themselves. If you want to catch that woman, simply killing her won't be enough. You must be sure to take that necklace from her as well.
I'd like to know the value of that necklace.
물질적인 것으로 계산한다고 해도 상당한 값을 하지만, 우리에게 있어서는: Even measured in material terms it's worth a great deal, but to us, isn't it worth even more than that? It's practically that woman's very life. Ha ha. If you have the pendant or bijou from that necklace, I'll trade you something finer than anything else I own. As you know, the pendant is more precious than the bijou. There's a difference between the two - do you wish to trade?
Yes, I'll trade Gilles de Rais's pendant.
Yes, I'll trade Gilles de Rais's bijou.
No. I'm sorry, but I don't wish to trade. I'll be on my way now.
Today too... for the great Lord Vlad... give it your all... heh heh~
If only we'd acted... just a little faster... we could have destroyed Bathory.
Be careful of Aiman. You never know when that one will stab you in the back.
위대한 블라드님을 위해서... 오늘도.. 많은 인간들을.. 우리 동족으로: For the great Lord Vlad... today too, we must turn many humans into our kind.
Isn't red blood beautiful? Everything can be made pure through blood.
바토리놈들을 없애야하네. 그놈들의 씨를 말려야 해!: We must wipe out Bathory's followers. We must exterminate them, root and all!
지금의 자신이 강하다고 생각하더라도, 무기와 비드를 사용한다면 더욱 강력: Even if you think you're strong now, using weapons and beads will let you unleash even greater power.
어려서부터 나는 랍비가 되려고 성경구절을 열심히 공부하고 스승님께서 가르: Ever since I was young, I studied scripture diligently to become a rabbi, memorizing again and again what my teacher taught me. But one day, a passage about atonement through blood struck me as strange. I must have been about fifteen then. All I knew back then was that atonement came through His great grace. But once I became fixated on the word 'blood'... I couldn't reach a conclusion. So from then on, I wandered from place to place, seeking true salvation through atonement. One day I met Lord Vlad, and as we spoke of blood... every single word of his struck a chord deep in my heart. When he finished speaking, he vanished before me without a trace. I searched for him for ten years. When I finally found him, I knelt before him and begged to be taken as his disciple. He alone... was my salvation...
그러셨군요. 그런데... 랍비는 어떤 사람을 가리키는 말입니까?: I see. But... what exactly does 'rabbi' mean?
I'm curious... what the battle against Bathory was like.
I'll be going now. Thank you for telling me.
궁금한 것이 있다구? 대체 자네의 궁금증을 어디 한번 들어볼까?: You have something you're curious about? Well then, let's hear it.
랍비셨다고 들었습니다. 랍비는 어떤 사람을 가리키는 말입니까?: I heard you were once a rabbi. What does 'rabbi' mean?
I'd like to hear about the battle against Bathory.
당신은...왜... 뱀파이어가 되었고 블라드님과는 어떻게 만나셨는지요?: Why... did you become a vampire, and how did you meet Lord Vlad?
Ah! I hope I haven't intruded on your precious time. I'll be going now.
랍비는 나의 선생님이라는 뜻의 헤브라이어로, 라보니(rabboni)라고도: 'Rabbi' is Hebrew for 'my teacher,' also called 'rabboni.' Anyone who wishes to become a rabbi must study a great deal of the Old Testament and the Talmud. A rabbi generally presides over Jewish religious events and various rites, and takes a wide part in educational activities. They're also involved in relief and service work for their community, and support all sorts of communal endeavors. I too... once, long ago... taught the word of God to others and served as His servant. Hmm... do you understand rabbis better now?
네.... 그런데... 왜.. 뱀파이어가 되셨고. 블라드님과는 어떻게 만: Yes... but... why did you become a vampire, and how did you meet Lord Vlad?
Kaim... I've taken up a great deal of your precious time... Well then... farewell.
바토리와의 전투라...참... 참담했지. 우리쪽 진영에서... 그 간사한: The battle against Bathory... it was truly dreadful. Because of that one conniving woman, our side lost many fine soldiers. Still, a few of Bathory's own - men marked for death - crawled over to our side and sold us information. We learned of a shortcut and were able to push into the lair quickly. What a shame, though. We should have finished Bathory off then. Even now she still lives, still troubling Lord Vlad. If only we'd been a little faster... we could have finished her. What a shame~
카임... 이만 가보겠습니다. 바토리놈들을... 하나라도.. 더 제거해야: Kaim... I'll be going now. I need to eliminate at least one more of Bathory's followers. Well then... take care.
You still lack blood. Go and drink more. A great deal more... heh heh heh.
어서오세요. 무엇을 도와드릴까요?: Welcome. How may I help you?
I need something. Please show me your goods.
가지고 있는 물건들을 좀 팔고 싶습니다. 값을 후하게 쳐 주시겠습니까?: I'd like to sell some of my things. Could you give me a fair price?
I'd like to go to the Field Headquarters.
I'll come by another time. There's nothing I need right now.
Be careful. This place is always dangerous.
I'll pray that you return here alive.
전투 중에 입은 상처를 내버려 둔다면 뱀파이어가 될 가능성이 높으니 빨리: If wounds taken in battle are left untreated, there's a high chance of turning into a vampire, so they must be treated quickly.
당신들이 필요한 물건들을 구비해 놓고 있습니다. 필요한 것만 말씀해 주세: I have the supplies you need in stock. Just tell me what you require.
Many people have been badly wounded. We need to move them quickly and treat them.
Did you know? Blue Drop has another name - 'Adam's Tears.'
자유대결지대는 동족간의 대결을 위한 '올트'와 동족,타 종족에 관계없이: The Free Combat Zone has 'Olt' for duels between your own kind, and 'Vanatul' where you can freely fight regardless of race. Please choose.
감사합니다. %(UserName)님께서는 %(GuildName)의 팀원으: Thank you. %(UserName), as a member of %(GuildName), you are donating in the name of %(GuildName). The amount you've donated will be posted on the website under your team's name. The posted amount will be shown as a combined total. The precious donations gathered in the name of %(GuildName) will be put to good use wherever they're truly needed, wherever a helping hand is called for.
어떻게 여기까지 왔지? 저 길을 따라 왔다면, 자네 실력이 있는 걸? 엄: How did you make it here? If you came by that road, you must have some real skill - there are plenty of fearsome things lurking out there. So, what brings you to me?
물건을 보관하고 싶습니다. 보관함을 하나 주시겠습니까?: I'd like to store some items. Could you give me a storage box?
I'd like to check that my items are safe.
I need an accessory. Please show me what you have.
이 애물단지들이 말썽을 좀 부리는군요. 좀 고쳐주시겠습니까?: These troublesome things are acting up. Could you repair them for me?
I'd like to retrieve the motorcycle I left with you.
Ah, I came to the wrong place. Well then...
조심하게. 여긴 정신을 빼놓고 돌아다녀도 될 만한, 그런 만만한 곳이 아: Be careful. This isn't the kind of place where you can wander around with your guard down!
아무리 실력이 있어도 갑자기 뱀파이어의 공격을 받아 세상 하직하는 건 한: No matter how skilled you are, a sudden vampire attack can end your life in an instant.
You look like you're carrying a lot. Let me hold onto it - you just focus on the fight.
타인의 목숨만큼 자네 목숨도 중요하다는 것을 잊지 말게. 항상 조심하고!: Don't forget that your life matters just as much as anyone else's. Always be careful!
Bring me anything that needs repair. I'll fix it up good as new.
이곳에서 팔고 있는 악세사리들은 특별한 것이라네. 보통 다른 상점에서 보: The accessories sold here are special - items you don't usually find in other shops.
후후, 어쩐 일로 여기까지 오시었나~: Heh heh, what brings you all the way here~
혹시 쓸만한 물건들이 있나 해서 찾아왔습니다. 물건을 볼 수 있을까요?: I came to see if you have anything useful. Could I take a look at your goods?
I'd like to sell off some of my things.
I'd like to go inside Limbo Castle.
I'd like to go inside Lasen Castle.
I was passing by and stopped in to check on you. Well then...
슬레이어들을 쓸어주게. 자꾸 슬레이어들의 모습을 보면 웬지 불안해져서 말: Wipe out the Slayers for me. Somehow it unsettles me whenever I keep seeing them around.
If there's an accessory you need, tell me. I'll get it for you.
아직도 여기에 남은 인간들이 몇 있다고 하더군. 인간들 모두 종족으로 만: I hear there are still a few humans left around here. Turn every one of them into our kind.
그래야. 숫적으로 우세할 수 있을 거 같으니까 말야. 하하: That's right. That way we'll have the numbers on our side. Ha ha.
만약 자네에게 특별한 힘이 있다면, 블루 드롭이 자네를 더 강하게 만들어: If you have a special power, Blue Drop will make you even stronger.
내게 있는 물건은 더할 나위 없이 화려하고 대단한 것들이 많다네. 이 물: What I have are the finest, most splendid things you could ask for. It took a very long time to acquire them all.
나 말고도 림보성이나 라센성에서 특별한 아이템들을 판매하는 이들이 있다네: Besides me, there are others in Limbo Castle and Lasen Castle who sell special items. If you're interested, go take a look.
자유대결지대는 동족간의 대결을 위한 '올테니아'와 동족,타 종족에 관계없: The Free Combat Zone has 'Oltenia' for duels between your own kind, and 'Vanatul' where you can freely fight regardless of race. Choose one.
안녕하세요? 어떻게 여기까지 오셨나요? 슬레이어들이 나오는, 무시무시한: Hello there. How did you make it all the way here? Be careful of that terrifying road where the Slayers appear - we never know when they'll try to wipe us all out. Hmm, so why have you come?
혈청이나 씰 같은 것들을 사고 싶은데?: I'd like to buy some serum or seals.
물건 좀 보관하려는데, 보관함 하나 내어주겠니?: I want to store some items - could you give me a storage box?
I want to check on the items I stored before - show me.
그리피스, 이것 좀 고쳐주겠니?: Griffith, could you fix this for me?
I'd like to see the pet storage.
I was passing by and wanted to check that you're doing well.
Heavy items are a hassle to carry around. I'll keep them safe for you.
여긴 맘 놓고 인간들을 상대할 수 있어 재밌죠. 후훗: It's fun here - I can deal with the humans without a worry. Heh heh.
If you have anything that needs fixing, bring it here. I'll make it good as new.
좀 깨끗하게 사용해 주세요. 제가 고치지도 못할 정도로 만들어 놓으시면: Please take a bit better care of your things. Don't wreck them so badly that even I can't fix them.
My favorite color is red. It looks so delicious.
전투가 힘들어질 것 같으면, 저한테 혈청이랑 변신 아이템을 꼭 준비해서: If a fight looks like it's going to get tough, be sure to stock up on serum and transformation items from me. It'll help, even if just a little.
머피 아저씨가 갖고 있는 물건들은 상점에서 좀처럼 보기 힘들었던 좋은 것: Everything Mr. Murphy has is quality stuff you rarely see in shops. I wonder where he gets it all.
클랜 차원에서 모금에 참여할께: I'll take part in the fundraiser on behalf of the clan.
Then I'll donate as an individual.
Have you come to clear the red mark from your record? You know the procedure, right? So... how much do you want cleared?
I'd like to exchange stars for items.
I'd like to exchange stars for money.
I came here about my team.
팀 때문에 찾아왔다면, 구체적으로 어떤 사항에 대한 건가?: If you're here about your team, what exactly is it regarding?
I've come to register a team.
I'd like to view the pending team list.
I'd like to view the team list.
I'd like to leave the team.
탈퇴하겠다고? 신중하게 생각했다면 자네의 탈퇴 신청을 받아들이겠지만 이것: You want to leave? If you've thought it through carefully, I'll accept your request, but know this: after leaving a team, no other team will take you in right away. Even if you try to join elsewhere, a full week must pass in real time. Do you still wish to leave the team?
I understand, but I still wish to leave.
In that case, I'll think it over again.
나는 E.V.E 제 2부대 TEAM TWO 의 리더 알프레드 엠마뉴엘 스: I am Alfred Emmanuel Smith, leader of E.V.E. 2nd Squadron, Team Two. Just call me Smith.
For now, we're using this building as E.V.E.'s temporary base.
모든 것에 우선하는 것은, 뱀파이어들의 우두머리인 뱀파이어 마스터들을 처: Above all else, our priority is to destroy the Vampire Masters, the leaders of the vampires.
First, deal with the low-level vampires that have made their way into the village.
카이저 부대장님을 만나봤는가? 그분은 잘 계시던가?: Have you met Deputy Commander Kaiser? Is he doing well?
일단은 내가 임시 사령관직을 맡고 있으니 중요한 일이 있으면 꼭 보고하도: For now I'm serving as acting commander, so be sure to report to me if anything important comes up.
너무 어린 나이에 빨리 높은 자리에 오른다해도 별로 좋지는 않다네.. 그: Rising to a high position too young isn't necessarily a good thing... it comes with just as heavy a responsibility...
나약해져서는 안되네. 자기자신과의 싸움에서 진다면 자네는 이곳에서 그들에: You mustn't grow weak. If you lose the fight against yourself, you'll end up here as nothing more than a blood donor to them.
힘들고 어려울때 가족들의 얼굴을 떠올리게나. 나자신이 지켜야 할 무언가: When times are hard, picture your family's faces. If there's something you must protect, something you want to keep safe, fight hard and win.
그들을 없애고 싶다면 그들에 대한 미움을 키우게나. 그래야 자네가 더 강: If you want to destroy them, cultivate your hatred for them. Remember, that's what will make you stronger.
자신이 군인이라는 것을 항상 잊지말도록!: Never forget that you are a soldier!
고칠게 있으면 다 내게 가져와. 내 손이 닿는 순간, 뚝딱! 새 것처럼: Bring me anything that needs fixing. The moment my hands touch it - presto! Good as new... Come on, now...
There's something I'd like to ask.
I came here about my clan.
Yes. Please fix this for me.
혹시 내가 흥미있을 만한 것이 있나?: Is there anything here that might interest me?
이걸 팔고 싶군. 어때?: I'd like to sell this. What do you say?
클랜때문이라... 구체적으로 어떤 것을 원하는건가?: About your clan... what exactly do you need?
I've come to register a clan.
I'd like to view the pending clan list.
I'd like to view the clan list.
I'd like to leave the clan.
It seems there's nothing else I need here.
클랜을 탈퇴하겠다고? 신중하게 생각해 보았나? 음... 자네의 탈퇴 신청: You want to leave the clan? Have you thought it through carefully? Hmm... I'll accept your request, but know this: once you leave, no other clan will easily take you in. Since you're the one breaking the oath... even if you try to join elsewhere, a full week must pass in real time before it's possible.
림보성의 림보가 무슨뜻인줄 아는가? 바로 연옥이라는 뜻이지. 어때. 잘: Do you know what 'Limbo' in Limbo Castle means? It means purgatory. Well? Fitting name, isn't it?
뭐 고칠 게 있으면 내게 이야기하게: If you have anything that needs fixing, just tell me.
Lord Vrykolakas's hidden power is probably even greater than Lady Bathory's.
블라드 테페스가 우리 바토리님에게 한 짓을 자네 알고 있나?: Do you know what Vlad Tepes did to our Lady Bathory?
내게서 뭐가 궁금한 게지? 어디 한번 들어보지 뭐~: What is it you want to know from me? Well, let's hear it~
인간이었을 때 당신은 어떤 일을 하셨나요?: What did you do when you were human?
How did you come to meet Lady Bathory...
흑마법은 어떻게 배우셨나요?: How did you learn black magic?
I think I should be going now.
내 겉모습을 보면 무엇이었는지.. 알 것 같지 않나? 나는 부족의 샤먼의: Looking at my appearance, can't you guess what I was? I held the position of shaman in my tribe - an Indian who longed for eternal life. A bit unusual, isn't it? Most in my position take a great interest in the afterlife, but I have no interest in life after death.
음.. 바토리님은.. 내가 뱀파이어가 되도록 도와주신분일세. 그 분을 어: Hmm... Lady Bathory is the one who helped me become a vampire. How did I meet her, you ask? I followed Lord Vrykolakas, and there she was. I offered her my blood... and in return, I gained eternal life. After that, I became her servant of my own will.
인간이었을때 당신은 어떤 일을 하셨나요?: What did you do when you were human?
나는 살아 있을때가 중요하다고 생각하지. 그래서 내 삶을 좀 더 늘리고: I've always believed that life while you're living it is what matters most. So all I wanted was to extend my own life a little longer. Then it occurred to me that black magic might let me achieve what I wanted. So I traveled from place to place, studying black magic. Along the way... I met Lord Vrykolakas. Even now I consider meeting him a stroke of luck... anyone who studies magic has probably heard of him, the famous black magician.
